newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse climbs in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse climbs in moderate trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange (GSE) index edged upwards on Wednesday, buoyed by a recovery of Ashanti Goldfields Company (up 100 cedis to 21,300 cedis), and Standard Chartered (up 100 to 5,100).
The Ghana All-Share index climbed by 1.38 points to 362.99 from 361.61 on Monday.
Ashanti Goldfields Company's rise followed a drop of 60 cedis in the previous session.
Other risers included Kumasi Brewery (+10 to 720), Mechanical Lloyd Company (+2 to 57), Accra Brewery Limited (+1 to 606) and Guinness Ghana Limited (+1 to 356).
The only loser was Fan Milk Limited (-1 to 388).
Trade volume was moderate as 38,390 shares changed hands compared with 12,230 on Monday. Bids continued to outpace offers by 3,920,300 to 731,990.

GSE said trading will be suspended for Easter Holidays on March 28 and March 31. Trading will resume on April 1 and April 2. Transactions effected on April 1 will be due for settlement on April 2, GSE said in a statement.
